page.overview:
What is Krang?

Tsathoggua (cousin) Yog-Sothoth (cousin)|affiliations=Great Old Ones}}

Krang is a fictional entity created by the late American author and H. P. Lovecraft contemporary R. H. Barlow for his 1934 short story "The Tomb of the God".

A monstrous brown, leathery, alien entity, which came to the planet Antanôk when dark magical powers battled for possession of the universe, Krang once slumbered within a gigantic mausoleum lost in the desert-wastes. When the men of Phoor opened this tomb, Krang awakened and ate them. (: "The Tomb of the God") It is said that Krang then joined his cousins, Cthulhu, Yog-Sothoth and Tsathoggua in the star-spaces. (: "The City in the Desert")

At one point Krang encountered and hid from a greater god, Tsathoggua. (: "The Deplorable Voyage") Category:Characters Originating From Lovecraft Circle Works Category:Other Supernatural Beings Category:Great Old Ones
